name: rinku
description: A local-first app for saving, organizing, and revisiting links.
author: Colin Devroe <colin@cdevroe.com> (https://cdevroe.com)

scripts.test: node scripts/test-core.js && node scripts/test-title-fetcher.js && node scripts/test-library-watcher.js && node scripts/test-import-unmark.js && node scripts/test-cli.js && node scripts/test-mcp.js && node scripts/test-capture-server.js && node scripts/test-api.js
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:release && npm run test:build-proxy && npm run test:mac-signing && npm run test:safari && npm run test:playwright
scripts.dist:mac:arm64:no-notarize: npm run build:icons && CSC_LINK= CSC_KEY_PASSWORD= RINKU_SKIP_NOTARIZATION=1 node scripts/dist-mac.js --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:all: npm run dist:mac:arm64 && npm run dist:mac:x64 && npm run dist:mac:universal
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win nsis --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:x64: npm run build:icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:arm64: npm run build:icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win nsis --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:x64: npm run build:icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:arm64: npm run build:icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux AppImage deb --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:all: npm run dist:linux:x64 && npm run dist:linux:arm64
scripts.dist:linux:rpm:x64: npm run build:icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux rpm --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:rpm:arm64: npm run build:icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux rpm --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:rpm:all: npm run build:icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux rpm --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:all: npm run dist:mac && npm run dist:win && npm run dist:linux
scripts.release:prepare: npm run dist:all && npm run release:verify
